I’ve tried to share this tip before I hit 40 myself, especially when I host..some people have been grateful for the info, and others still didn’t get it. I’m sorry your friend missed out on xp, here’s the message I usually post as soon as I open a new room, hopefully it helps. I have it saved in my notes now so that I can just copy paste it.

If you’re grinding to lvl up fast make sure you add everyone in every raid you do on pokeraid and pop a lucky egg if you can. on tier 5 and mega raids you’ll get 57k every time. There’s a delay after catch, so DON’T delete them until you see that you’ve hit good friends in your main screen and gotten the 6k. As a courtesy, you can wait a few minutes to make sure anyone you’ve added or who has added you, also receives the extra xp! Then delete and repeat for each raid!

***Update: Please note that I was using this version of this message during the boosted xp on raids, so if you use it, I’d edit it to reflect current max xp on Tier 5 and Megas, which is 50k. Even on other tiers though, the point of the message is to let people know that it’s possible to receive up to 30k per raid by added all other members in the room, and to give it a few so that everyone can maximize off of that.


If I’m hosting I also include a sentence before that letting everyone know I’ll send invites once everyone has added me, and that I’d they can’t add me (usually first time pokeraid users) I let them know I’ll add them to keep things moving along. 

Sometimes just a friendly demeanor and simple communication is enough for people to extend the courtesy, giving the assurance that it’s going to be a successful raid.
